$comment: The four recipes (act4 doc §7, plan §3.9, ADR-149) — crafted at a base's bench (the kitchen table that didn't fit). The bench's conversation is built from this file (`craft:bench`).

recipes.name: Smoke bomb
recipes.line: Cloth into the bottle, something that burns badly. It will smoke for half a minute.

recipes.name: Noise maker
recipes.line: Stones in the tumbler, a string round the rim. It will be loud where you throw it.

recipes.name: UV torch
recipes.line: The LED soldered where the bulb was, the power bank taped on. It glows purple. They flinch from purple.

recipes.name: Bandage
recipes.line: Boil the water, boil the cloth, tear it in two.
